pairs.subject: trailer-structure
pairs.evidence: lib/script/trailer/report.ts:62 The engine models six of the seven techniques as typed data and checks, but concealment-and-its-tells has only a standing unmeasured row: no TrailerCut carries a signal for the honesty limit (does the cut still convey how the work feels to use), so a cut that hides its experiential product completely gets no finding beyond that row.

techniques.evidence: lib/script/trailer/report.ts:62 The code states the gap itself. Mislead is routed to the promise ledger (PromiseSource 'assembly'), but the honesty limit and per-shot subtraction are not realized; the report emits one unmeasured row instead.

lib/script/trailer/types.ts:373 The cue is a field of the cut, and movements and beats point into it through cueSection and cueMark. composeCut requires a cue (cut.ts:47). Caveat: beats still carry an authored `at` timecode that does not depend on the cue.

lib/script/trailer/types.ts:245 The budget is keyed to the campaign, not the cut. It holds the five named asset kinds, the spend/imply/hold allowances and a trade field for each spend. The model's patch fields (plan.ts:33) cannot touch allowances, so whoever is measured on the cut cannot set the budget.

lib/script/trailer/types.ts:270 Payer is an explicit field and source can be claim, register or assembly. Spend-vs-debt is recorded as spentByTheCut. The ledger is advisory and never a gate, through ADVISORY_RULES read from params (thresholds.ts:105).
lib/script/trailer/types.ts:331 The raised variable is an explicit field, as the 'in a tool' rule asks. It is an array so that a rung raising several variables can be expressed and then detected.

lib/script/trailer/thresholds.ts:94 One structural reset, the too-many threshold and holds-per-reset are read from params. resetHolds is an array (types.ts:345) so that a reset holding two ideas can be detected.
lib/script/trailer/types.ts:291 The drop order is stored as data in the doctrine's order. Runtimes and per-rung part counts are deliberately not encoded.
